name: BUILDS
description: Things I made and put on the internet: websites, Nostr accounts that post on their own, Telegram bots, and the odd tool that exists because I wanted it. Everything here is online now.

subInterests.name: WEB
subInterests.description: Sites and web apps, each one live.

subInterests.name: SATOSHI.SI
subInterests.description: Bitcoin tools, wallet education and news: BIP39 resources, price conversion, historical charts, a NIP-05 desk and a Lightning payment service.

subInterests.name: BIRDS.NAME
subInterests.description: A multilingual bird guide: what a bird is called in each language, a description from Wikipedia and its conservation status.

subInterests.name: FERMENTIMER.COM
subInterests.description: A fermentation timer and tracker for kombucha, sourdough, kimchi, kefir and yogurt: stage timers, notes, history, a calendar.

subInterests.name: PINSTR.SI
subInterests.description: Sign a temporary Nostr note and pin it to a public geohash board: something that happened, where it happened, paid for in sats.

subInterests.name: LABELAB.NET
subInterests.description: A private, local label maker: barcodes, QR codes, text labels, warning signs, laid out on your own paper size.

subInterests.name: RED BULL GONI PONY
subInterests.description: Results and history of the Red Bull Goni Pony race up Vršič: every edition, every rider, the times and the stories.

subInterests.name: BAUHAUS ORDER MERGER
subInterests.description: Merges several Bauhaus PDF purchase orders into one, so every article appears once with the total quantity across all of them - built for preparing stock in the warehouse.

subInterests.name: SNOFL.COM
subInterests.description: NostrPostr: write a note and publish it to Nostr from a plain web page, no client to install.

subInterests.name: UPSY.SI
subInterests.description: A wire watching superintelligence happen: AI articles and podcast episodes from eighty sources, each with a description you can read before committing an hour.

subInterests.name: SHITSTR.COM
subInterests.description: A poop sound sequencer. It does exactly what the name says.

subInterests.name: NOSTR
subInterests.description: Accounts and bots posting to Nostr - open the link to see them on a relay reader.

subInterests.name: APOD
subInterests.description: Astronomy Picture of the Day, posted to Nostr.

subInterests.name: SCITECHDAILY
subInterests.description: Science and technology news, posted to Nostr.

subInterests.name: I FEEL SLOVENIA
subInterests.description: Slovenian things worth seeing, posted to Nostr.

subInterests.name: IA39 BOT
subInterests.description: A bot posting IPA39 library records to Nostr.

subInterests.name: BARKING NEWS
subInterests.description: The news, as a bot that barks it into Nostr.

subInterests.name: NEO
subInterests.description: Near-Earth objects: what is passing close, posted to Nostr.

subInterests.name: TELEGRAM
subInterests.description: Bots you talk to in Telegram.

subInterests.name: VREMENKOBOT
subInterests.description: Weather for Slovenia, in a chat: forecast, radar, warnings.

subInterests.name: LIGHTNING LOTTERY
subInterests.description: A lottery settled over Lightning: buy a ticket in sats, the draw is a transaction.

subInterests.name: TRACKSTRBOT
subInterests.description: Drops a downloaded track into the right place with the right name, from a chat.

subInterests.name: NOTAMCHECKBOT
subInterests.description: Checks NOTAMs for a flight and says what matters: closures, restrictions, the lines that actually affect the day.

subInterests.name: OTHER
subInterests.description: Tools and data that do not need a server of their own.

subInterests.name: SWATCHER
subInterests.description: Private, watch-only Bitcoin monitoring on StartOS, with a local Electrs and alerts over NIP-17 or Telegram.

subInterests.name: BIP39 EXOTICA
subInterests.description: Generates Bitcoin and Nostr keys from standard and exotic wordlists: import into apps, build Nostr keys from a mnemonic, recover a key from colours, or make one out of "rock, paper, scissors, lizard, spock".

subInterests.name: BIP39 SLOVENIAN WORDLIST
subInterests.description: 2048 unique Slovenian words, picked and sorted from the Dictionary of the Slovenian Standard Language, so a seed phrase can live in the language its owner thinks in.

subInterests.name: HERMES TRAY
subInterests.description: A tiny PyQt6 tray client for Hermes Agent: streaming replies, a live tool feed, sessions, and approval prompts as real dialogs.
